craft_notes: Sthāyin: question-turned (body then worshipper). Rows: row 3 (who/which open pair). Rupture: colon after stainless — property, then question. Close: reality? (open). Rejected: answering the riddle — killed: v17 answers; 'object' — killed: body kept.

lines: That body must be known in truth — stainless,
world-filling: who worships, which pleased, in such reality?
l4.sanskrit_cite: tad vapus tattvato jñeyaṃ vimalaṃ viśvapūraṇam | evaṃvidhe pare tattve kaḥ pūjyaḥ kaś ca tṛpyati

reads_against.argmap: What is that body, and who worships? → The body is stainless world-filling — and worship itself becomes the question.
c1_essence: Stainless world-filling body: who worships, which pleased?
reads_against.c1_rasa: adbhuta settling toward śānta (wonder of the unspeakable)
